articles.summary: Kodiak AI plans to launch unsupervised driverless trucking on the Dallas-Houston I-45 lane by year end, after consistent intervention-free deliveries.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Names Dallas-Houston As Long-Haul Driverless Launch Lane, Consistently Completes Intervention-Free, End-to-End Deliveries

articles.summary: Kodiak and DTL Transport complete the first autonomous deliveries under Kodiak's new California DMV permit, hauling perishable freight from Fresno to LA.
articles.title: Kodiak AI and DTL Transport Complete First Autonomous Trucking Deliveries Under New California DMV Permit

articles.summary: Kodiak AI remains on track to launch driverless long-haul service by the end of 2026. Its Autonomy Readiness Measure reached 93% in August, up from 91%.
articles.title: Kodiak AI On Track For Year-End Driverless Long-Haul Launch as Safety Case Readiness Reaches 93%

articles.summary: A new collaboration integrates Kodiak's autonomous truck inspection data into PrePass' nationwide bypass network, paving the way for driverless scaling.
articles.title: PrePass and Kodiak AI Collaborate to Advance Safe, Scalable Driverless Trucking Nationwide

articles.summary: After four years, 1,300+ loads and 750,000 autonomous miles together, IKEA will be Kodiak's driverless launch partner on a 219-mile I-45 route in Texas.
articles.title: Kodiak and IKEA: Launching Driverless Service in 2026 After Four Years of Partnership
